notes: Corrected 2026 audit: file previously listed alpha=0.08 and alpha/beta=11.4 Gy, which did not match the paper's published headline result. Verified overall published values (PubMed/ScienceDirect/RedJournal, all consistent): alpha = 0.06 +/- 0.05 Gy^-1, alpha/beta = 10.0 +/- 15.1 Gy, Td = 50 +/- 30 days, repair half-time = 0.5 h (matches the file's Td and repair half-time, which were already correct). The paper separately reports that Grade III and Grade IV astrocytomas had different LQ parameters, but the specific grade-level alpha/alpha-beta values could not be independently confirmed from the abstract/secondary sources within this audit (full text paywalled) - treat the previously-listed grade-specific figures (III: 0.18/6.0, IV: 0.09/9.0) as unverified.
